prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the EXACT pose and character to preserve: the paper hero with BOTH legs tightly folded under the body. Input image2 is the old dash sheet, supplied ONLY as style reference; its running/foot-strike poses are WRONG and must NOT be repeated. Draw a NEW 2x2 equal-cell sprite sheet with FOUR subtle variations of image1's compact tucked dash pose. This is a low forward gliding DASH, NOT running or stepping. In ALL FOUR cells, BOTH thighs are tucked under the torso, BOTH knees bent tightly, BOTH lower legs folded backward, and BOTH small feet kept close to the hips under the cloak. Neither foot ever extends downward or touches ground. NO kick, planted sole, running stride, alternating leg cycle, straight shin, rear leg push-off, landing step or stretched limb. Keep this SAME leg configuration for frame1, frame2, frame3 AND frame4.
Character invariants: huge round warm ivory head with single black oval eye near right edge, short compact legs and plain shorts, hands and arms entirely inside long layered soft paper cloak, subtle matte paper texture, broad curved paper folds, dark thin warm outlines. Same head size/proportions/palette as image1, no redesign. Strict right side profile with head leading hips and torso leaning strongly forward, almost horizontal compact gliding posture. Cloak streams LEFT behind body with long rounded wave shapes, no spikes. Body height and angle stay almost constant.
Top-left: tucked dash begins, knees already folded; cloak drawn back in a gentle lower wave.
Top-right: tucked dash continues, SAME two folded legs; cape wave extends a little straighter behind.
Bottom-left: tucked dash continues, SAME two folded legs; small upward cape wave at rear, body tilts only 2 degrees more forward.
Bottom-right: tucked dash releases speed, STILL BOTH LEGS FOLDED with NO foot reaching down, cloak wave relaxes slightly. Running starts only AFTER this sheet.
True transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside each silhouette. No backdrop, glow, cast shadow, floor, labels, grid, text, motion lines or baked trails. All four complete characters inside their cells with ample margin, same scale, no cropping or overlap. Full-body animation drawings, not joint pieces.

processing: Crop complete full-body drawings and uniformly register head width160px, head center[412,308], with pivot x364 to preserve the displayed head position for every frame. Preserve generated alpha. No joint deformation or forced foot contact.
poseRequirement: Both knees and both feet remain tucked underneath the forward-leaning body across ALL 4 frames. No push-off stride, foot strike or run-exit leg extension inside the dash clip.
runtime: Same ground/air dash controls, duration180ms, speed640px/s, cooldown and jump/fall recovery. Only artwork and its registration change.
